import tarfile
import subprocess

def extract_file(archive):
    tar = tarfile.open('./archives/'+archive)
    tar.extractall(path='../')
    tar.close()

def play_game():
    subprocess.run(['python','game.py'])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    extract_file('game.tar.gz')
    play_game()
